title: Half-hour triage docket - Ryan
content:
Half-hour triage docket - quick notes (overnight -> morning handoff)
Owner: Ryan Cho (oncall)
Date: 2026-04-04 00:30-01:00 local
Context: short-form capture of pages, immediate followups, and runbook TODOs to avoid losing momentum. Not a postmortem — just a working docket for morning handoff.

Summary of pages:
- 00:12 - P1: api-gateway 5xx surge (alert: gateway-5xx-rate) -> downstream 503 cascade to frontend routes. Pager fired at 00:12.
  - Initial mitigation: scaled gateway pool + temporary rate limit bump for internal health checks (kubectl patch hpa). 00:18 service recovered to baseline.
  - Observations: spike correlated with a burst of internal evaluation jobs from tenant-42 (dedicated). Need rate-limiting for tenant burst.
  - Short term note: delegated to SRE runbook step A (scale + wait). Worked but manual hooks were fiddly.

- 00:47 - P2: long-tail tokenization latency (embedder-node-3) -> degraded batching throughput, causing queued requests and increased p99.
  - Root cause suspicion: tokenization library regressed after recent pip upgrade in staging -> prod rollout flagged? Check wheel versions.
  - Action: rolled back embedder image to v2026.03.15 at 01:05 -> p99 dropped.
  - Follow-ups: open JIRA OPS-4921 (created), link below. Coordinate with applied-ml to pin tokenizer wheel.

Operational TODOs (immediate, put on morning list):
- [ ] Add tenant-level burst protection for evaluation jobs (short-term: per-tenant QPS cap in gateway). Priority: high.
- [ ] Add a small playbook section for "scale gateway emergency" with exact kubectl commands and expected metric checks. Current runbook references an old HPA command that doesn't match new helm values. Priority: med-high.
- [ ] Verify embedder node image promotion pipeline; add explicit tokenization wheel SHA pin in image builder. Priority: high.
- [ ] Add synthetic tokenization canary job that runs whenever embedder image is promoted. Priority: med.

Runbook gaps / notes to fix:
- Runbook step for gateway surge references helm release name 'gateway' but our k8s manifests use 'api-gateway-prod'. Need to search+replace and add snippets for helm vs kubectl.
- No explicit rollback threshold documented for embedder regressions (we just guessed). Add p99 latency threshold and an automated rollback flow (git tag + image revert) in runbook.
- Observability: dashboard lacks a clear "tokenizer time per request" metric; file a metrics spike request.

Commands / quick snippets used (put in runbook later):
- kubectl -n prod scale deployment api-gateway --replicas=6  # when surge
- kubectl patch hpa api-gateway -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'  # emergency bump (helm override to follow)
- rollback embedder: kubectl set image ds/embedder embedder=registry/redwood/embedder:v2026.03.15

Notes for morning handoff (@maya, @ishaan):
- Maya: can you take ops lead on tenant rate limiting? I've sketched proposer config in the temp gist (linked in JIRA). Need review + quick deploy window.
- Ishaan: please follow up with applied-ml on tokenizer wheel pin (JIRA OPS-4921). Ask for changelog entry + recommended canary runtime.

Investigation breadcrumbs:
- Kibana: searched for 5xx spike 00:10-00:20 -> request volume spike from 10.3.22.14 (internal eval runner) with path /v1/execute-eval.
- Prometheus: gateway_5xx_rate increased from 0.2 -> 12 RPS at 00:12. Latency p99 overall hit 1.8s.
- Embedder logs: stack traces show new tokenization error handing leading to ~200ms extra per request for malformed inputs. Suspect wheel 2.1.4 -> 2.2.0 change.

Open questions / TODO at triage time:
- Why did the evaluation runner decide to burst at 00:12? Is there a scheduler bug or a retry loop? (Follow up with solutions-engineering: JOB-2345?)
- Should we implement backpressure at the gateway for internal clients by default (config flag per client id)?
- How to make the embedder promotion process include a small smoke test for tokenization? (CI hook?)

Follow-ups filed / next artifacts:
- JIRA OPS-4921: embedder tokenization regression (assigned to Ishaan).
- JIRA OPS-4922: gateway tenant burst protection config (assigned to Maya).
- PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842  (temp patch to add emergency commands and example helm override)
- Confluence runbook stub: CONFLUENCE-Runbook-API-Gateway (needs update)

Quick retro (lessons):
- We need clearer separation for internal evaluation traffic so tenant bursts don't affect public traffic. Dedicated concept was doing too much right now.
- Small automation (canary for tokenization) would have caught embedder regression earlier.

Notes to self:
- When adding runbook snippets, include exact namespace and helm release values (copy from prod helm state).
- Keep this doc short; convert to handoff email if needed.

-- End notes --
